source.description: The shard source: its alias, its shorthand, or its folder, for example "proj" or "Shards/(Source Remote) Projects".

commit.description: The SHA of the commit of the migration in the source. Set it in the step commit.

next.interactive: Load the source {{source}} with flint shard start-dev, run flint shard knap check-modes on its folder, and check git status. Write the plan and the list of paths, record BASE and the ledger of their hashes, compare the machine fields of each pair of invocation files, and find each artifact input that the workflow creates: bind it as create_and_do_task does, else keep the old format, else it is a conflict. Give the plan, the option of each creation input, and each conflict to the person. A conflict stops the whole migration: put back each path of the ledger that is yours as it is at BASE, do not delete, link, bump, or commit, close this invocation with flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome abandoned --reason '<the conflict>', and give the blocker.
next.headless: Load the source {{source}} with flint shard start-dev, run flint shard knap check-modes on its folder, and check git status. Write the plan and the list of paths, record BASE and the ledger of their hashes, compare the machine fields of each pair of invocation files, and find each artifact input that the workflow creates: bind it as create_and_do_task does, else keep the old format, else it is a conflict. Keep the plan and each conflict for the result. Do not wait for a person. A conflict stops the whole migration: put back each path of the ledger that is yours as it is at BASE, do not delete, link, bump, or commit, close this invocation with flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome abandoned --reason '<the conflict>', and give the blocker.

steps.title: Merge the Workflows
steps.next: Merge each dev-hwkfl- workflow of {{source}} that has a partner and no conflict into its dev-wkfl- workflow: a headless callout at the end of each stage that differs, nothing lost, no --headless. In a line that names a headless file, rewrite only the old reference. Run the guard before each write, then git rm the headless file. When the source has no pair, skip this step: flint shard step skip workflows --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: Merge the Invocation Files
steps.next: Merge each headless invocation file of {{source}}: compare the machine fields, use a next object where only the text differs, split a step whose calls, repeat, or evidence differ into one step for each mode, keep each required output and enforced guard of each mode, give a behaviour of one mode a session.mode key, update each old id, and keep the old format for a creation input of option 2. Delete the headless file only in a two-file merge; a lone file is renamed with git mv. A conflict stops the whole migration: put back each path of the ledger that is yours as it is at BASE, do not delete, link, bump, or commit, close this invocation with flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome abandoned --reason '<the conflict>', and give the blocker. When the source has no headless invocation file, skip this step: flint shard step skip invocation_files --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: Merge the Init
steps.next: Only when no conflict is open: move the content of the headless init of {{source}} into a section # Headless of the init: the interface keys, the phase values, the result delivery, and each rule. In a line that names a headless file, rewrite only the old reference, and keep each safety rule. Run the guard, then git rm the headless init. When the source has no headless init, skip this step: flint shard step skip init --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: A Headless Workflow with No Partner
steps.stage: Stage 5: A Headless Workflow with No Partner
steps.next: Rename the Markdown of each dev-hwkfl- workflow of {{source}} with no partner to dev-wkfl- with git mv, check that Stage 3 renamed its invocation file, keep it as a normal workflow with real stage headings, and add the line that it runs in a headless Orbh session. When each headless workflow has a partner, skip this step: flint shard step skip alone --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: Update the Links
steps.next: Only when no conflict is open: replace each link to a headless file, each hstart, and each --headless in the files of {{source}}, and update each caller of a creation input. Keep the release history. Then run flint shard knap check-modes on the folder again.

steps.title: Check
steps.next: Run flint shard knap check-modes on the folder of {{source}}, and the health check of the shard. Then open each changed invocation file in a scratch Flint in both modes, with the inputs of its callers, and set each creation input after its file exists. No headless file, no reference, no problem, and no deprecated warning may stay. A mode that fails is a conflict. A conflict stops the whole migration: put back each path of the ledger that is yours as it is at BASE, do not delete, link, bump, or commit, close this invocation with flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome abandoned --reason '<the conflict>', and give the blocker.

steps.title: Review
steps.next: Give the person the summary of the migration of {{source}}: the merged, renamed, and deleted files, each dropped line, each choice, and the check. Refine until the person confirms.

steps.title: Commit and Version
steps.next: Only when no conflict is open and the check of both modes passed: run the guard of your paths, bump the version of {{source}} (minor at 1.0.0 or above, patch for 0.x), run the guard again, and commit only your paths: git commit -- <path>, with each path. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} commit='<sha>'. A conflict stops the whole migration: put back each path of the ledger that is yours as it is at BASE, do not delete, link, bump, or commit, close this invocation with flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome abandoned --reason '<the conflict>', and give the blocker.

next.interactive: Search the other sources and the Mesh for the old names of the files of {{source}}, and list each place for the person. Do not edit another shard. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Search the other sources and the Mesh for the old names of the files of {{source}}, and put the list in the result. Do not edit another shard. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Then return with flint orbh session return --finish.
